text:
An in-tree contribution under `plugins/memory/` will not be accepted. 

According to the project policy, new memory backends are **closed to in-tree additions**. 

Instead, you should develop YantrikDB support as a standalone external plugin that:
1. Implements the `MemoryProvider` interface.
2. Can be distributed and installed directly into `~/.hermes/plugins/` or packaged via `pip` entry points.
